name: Release OTA Promote
description: Promote a runtime OTA over both channels: publish signed Electron UI/daemon bundles to an isolated local feed with atomic manifest switch and digest readback, while constructing (but not POSTing) the K8s drain_respawn rollout. --env prod is refused before writes. The top-level result remains blocked until the real K8s rollout is delivered.

sampleTasks.title: Publish the signed Electron local feed and prove K8s/prod boundaries
sampleTasks.prompt:
From the repo root, remove only `.e2e-tmp/apc-ota-feed`, then run `npx tsx sdk/apc/bin/apc.ts release ota-promote --env dev --desktop-feed-dir .e2e-tmp/apc-ota-feed --desktop-ui-meta apps/desktop/dist-ui/ui.manifest.json --desktop-daemon-meta apps/desktop/dist-ui/daemon.manifest.json --json`. This must copy the signed versioned bundles, atomically publish `manifest.json`, and read the files back. Report `desktop.status=applied`, `desktop.readback.verified=true`, and the real manifest path; do not claim Electron itself has checked/staged/applied the update because this verb only proves feed publication. The same product must say K8s `directive=drain_respawn` and `posted=false`, so top-level `decision=blocked`. Then run the prod command with the same feed arguments and prove it is blocked before any OTA write with `k8s.skipped=true`.

Use this exact report header, followed by both raw JSON products verbatim:
```
DIRECTIVE: drain_respawn
POSTED: false
DESKTOP: applied
DESKTOP-VERIFIED: true
RUN-EXIT: 1
PROD-DECISION: blocked
PROD-K8S-SKIPPED: true
PROD-RUN-EXIT: 1
```
Never report `kill1`, a K8s delivery, or an Electron client apply. The feed path must stay under `.e2e-tmp/`.
expectedArtifacts: both raw `apc release ota-promote --json` products (--env dev and --env prod) pasted verbatim
`DIRECTIVE` / `POSTED` / `DESKTOP` / `RUN-EXIT` lines equal to the dev product's fields
k8s{channel:admin-fleet-rollout, directive:drain_respawn, frame:runtime.update.apply, posted:false} — line 3, never line-1 kill1
desktop.status=applied + desktop.readback.verified=true + a manifest path under .e2e-tmp/
prod run: decision=blocked + k8s.skipped=true (no rollout request constructed) + non-empty blockers[]

acceptanceCriteria.label: the dev product proves a real local Electron feed publication by readback while preserving the K8s dry-run boundary
the prod human gate fired before any OTA work: --env prod is blocked with the K8s channel SKIPPED (k8s.skipped=true, so no rollout request was ever constructed) and a non-empty blocker

humanApprovalRequiredFor: promoting an OTA to any fleet (proper delivery = admin rollout endpoint drain_respawn, M5)
prod OTA promote is refused outright
